label: end-of-episode D1 after reward, about to choose a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (ep_trial 90-99, essentially none before trial 80; all activations sit in the lowest value-head bin, i.e. the end-of-episode value drop). Within that window it is strongly selective for an a1 policy: 97% of mass is on trials where the upcoming choice is a1 and 87% where the previous choice was a1; 92% of mass when the reward input is 1. It does not fire at GO or D2, before trial ~90, or (almost) when the agent is on a2. Magnitude ramps up over consecutive late-episode rewarded a1 trials. Recorded predicate uses the upcoming choice of the agent (action at D1, a legitimate computed quantity, flagged FUTURE only formally); dev P=0.74 R=0.76 F1=0.75 mass recall 0.86. Closest observed-only predicate, (phase == D1) & (ep_trial >= 93) & (prev_action != 2) & (in_rew == 1), scores dev F1=0.68, mass recall 0.86. The agent has no explicit clock input, so ep_trial is presumably tracked via an internal correlate (value decay).
